place.name: Royal Castle, Warsaw
place.description: The Royal Castle in Warsaw (Polish: Zamek Królewski w Warszawie [ˈzamɛk kruˈlɛfskʲi v varˈʂavjɛ]) is a former royal residence and seat of government in Warsaw, Poland. Located on Castle Square, at the entrance to the Old Town, it now houses a state museum with collections of Polish and European art.
